You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

What will Sylvie's annual salary be after three more years of service? The company pays each employee $600 per month. The company increases each employee's salary by 10% of the initial salary every year after the employee has stayed with the company for five years. Sylvie completed five years of service with the company last December. Sylvie receives her monthly salary for all 12 months of the year. The company applies the post-five-year salary adjustment before Sylvie's first paycheck of the new year. Sylvie's initial monthly salary was $600.
